description: Template: API keys for a READ-ONLY Tenable Security Center user whose role reaches only the repositories to be read, with the connection settings for that one instance. Copy it to tenable-<name>.secret.json under a private TAP_SECRETS_ROOT, rename the key to match the file, and replace every REPLACE_WITH value. network_name must name the one network this instance's results come from. Never commit the filled-in copy.
